response.rationale: A and B are the same concept: the honey harvest record. In A, ReportService (node a663bd12cbc0090c) loops over `this.harvests.findByHive(hive.id)`, and the graph shows that call goes to HarvestRepository.findByHive. HarvestRepository is constructor-injected into ReportService. In B, HarvestRepository (node cfa247680820ee47, src/persistence/repositories.ts) creates `HarvestRecord` entities, and the graph shows it is called by ReportService.quarterlyReport. So "Honey Harvest" in ReportService and "Harvest" in HarvestRepository refer to the same harvest records stored by HarvestRepository. One is the business view and the other is the stored data.
